title: Qormaata Uumama Qulqulluu
intro: Saba karaa irraa maqeef mallattoon ergame. Jireenya isaanii isa mijataa gidduutti akeekkachiisni tokko dhufe—uumama dinqisiisaa qorumsa amantii isaanii isa dhumaa taʼu tokko wajjin ture. Deebiin isaanii bara baraan hiree isaanii irratti chaappaa godha ture. Eenyu akka akeekkachiisa kana dabarsee fi warra didan maal akka ta’e saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Uummata ergamtoota kanaan dura nu dura turaniin qajeelfamne turre.
Uumamni ajaa'ibaa tokko gaara keessaa ba'e, saba kanaaf mallattoo Gooftaa keenya biraa ta'e.
Anis akkana jedheen: 'Kun gaala dubaraa kan Rabbiiti, kanaaf dachii Rabbii keessaa akka nyaattu dhiisaa, miidhaan ishee hin tuqinaa' jedheen.
Ummanni garuu ajaja Gooftaa isaanii cabsuun gaala koo dubaraa hamstrung.
Ani ergamaa Gooftaa kee biraa, dhugaa wajjin ergame qofa—Ani raajii fi gabricha amanamaa dha.
Warra badii hojjetan yoo ta’e, Gooftaan keenya sagalee qilleensaa isaan rukutee, mana isaanii keessatti sochii malee ta’an.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
